dialogue_segments.text: You have taken my place today.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: And you are doing it better than me.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.

sound_fx_segments.label: SOUND FX
sound_fx_segments.text: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

logline: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 13's cliffhanger where Juliana grasped the emerald ring beneath the razor-sharp blackthorns.
